page_services.title: Services
page_services.description: High-performance web development, security hardening, full-stack edge engineering, and architectural audits.
page_services.hero_description: I build modern web applications, scalable edge backends, and performance-first architectures tailored for reliability, accessibility, and speed.
page_services.benchmarks_description: Every project is engineered to meet strict web standards, guaranteeing perfect Lighthouse metrics and hardened HTTP security headers out of the box.
page_services.services_description: End-to-end web development services from conception to production deployment.
page_services.service_1_desc: Custom-built, lightning-fast web applications designed with modern edge architectures, responsive layouts, and zero unnecessary bloat.
page_services.service_1_feat_1: Sub-second load times & 100/100 Core Web Vitals
page_services.service_1_feat_2: Accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA) and mobile-first responsive design
page_services.service_2_desc: Proactive security posture integration to safeguard your web assets against common vulnerabilities, data leakage, and bot spam.
page_services.service_2_feat_1: Mozilla Observatory A+ grade HTTP security headers & strict CSP
page_services.service_2_feat_3: Safe input sanitization, CSRF mitigation, and TLS/SSL hardening
page_services.service_3_desc: Serverless APIs and database layers built on lightweight edge runtimes, ensuring global low latency and rock-solid scalability.
page_services.service_3_feat_1: Ultra-fast RESTful APIs with Hono & Cloudflare Workers
page_services.service_3_feat_2: Scalable serverless databases with PlanetScale & MySQL edge drivers
page_services.service_4_desc: Diagnostic evaluation and systematic refactoring of slow or legacy web codebases to modernize their stack and slash page weight.
page_services.service_4_feat_1: Comprehensive bottleneck diagnosis and code teardown
page_services.service_4_feat_2: Asset pipeline optimization (AVIF/WEBP, font subsets, tree-shaking)
page_services.service_4_feat_3: Migration from heavy legacy frameworks to clean modern stacks
page_services.process_description: A transparent, structured engineering process that prioritizes clarity, milestones, and high-quality deliverables.
page_services.step_1_desc: We analyze your project goals, technical requirements, and define the data models, UX structure, and edge stack.
page_services.step_2_desc: Iterative development using strict TypeScript, modular components, and constant progress visibility.
page_services.step_3_desc: Rigorous automated testing for accessibility, responsive viewports, Lighthouse metrics, and security headers.
page_services.step_4_desc: Zero-downtime global rollout, automated CI/CD pipelines, documentation, and seamless handover.
page_services.tech_description: Built on top of modern, battle-tested web technologies.
page_services.faq_description: Common questions about project scope, collaboration, and timelines.
page_services.faq_q1: What web technologies do you specialize in?
page_services.faq_a1: I primarily build with modern web frameworks and tools including Astro, TypeScript, UnoCSS, and SolidJS on the frontend, with Vite+, Hono, Cloudflare, and PlanetScale on the backend. This produces fast, lightweight, and cost-efficient edge deployments.
page_services.faq_q2: Can you audit or optimize my existing website?
page_services.faq_a2: Yes. I provide in-depth performance and security audits identifying bottleneck assets, unoptimized bundles, and missing security headers, along with direct code refactoring to bring your scores to 100/100 and A+.
page_services.faq_q3: How are projects scoped and priced?
page_services.faq_a3: Engagements can be structured as fixed-scope project milestones for well-defined builds, or on a flexible sprint/retainer basis for ongoing development and advisory. Every project includes clear deliverables and timelines upfront.
page_services.faq_a4: Reach out through the contact form with a brief summary of your project or requirements. I'll get back to you within 24–48 hours to discuss specifications, timeline, and next steps.
page_services.cta_final_title: Ready to bring your web project to life?
page_services.cta_final_desc: Let's build something fast, secure, and built to last. Reach out and let's discuss your requirements.
